marie (evals): Short heads-up: quick smoke of v3-rerank-int4 shows a surprising MRR@10 regression concentrated on very short queries (<=3 tokens). NDCG also down but less.

dan (ml): weird. PTQ usually hurts long docs more. What are the numbers?

marie (evals): holdout-5k: MRR@10 = 0.241 (baseline 0.289, delta -0.048 ~ -16.6%), NDCG@10 = 0.398 (baseline 0.412, delta -0.014). Short-query slice MRR down ~24% relative.

oliver (data): can you split by candidate length and source? Might be our short-query candidates are mostly snippets from answers-2024 vs fullpassages.

marie (evals): did that. The regressions are strongest when candidate docs are very short (<40 tokens) and when the query is punctuation-only or a 1-2 token function word. Examples: q_77, q_2401, q_6339.

kai (infra): any infra changes during the run? I rolled out a batching tweak last week that reduces micro-batch size when kvpack=true. Could batch shape affect quantized kernels?

dan (ml): potentially. Also check tokenizer: we recently shipped a whitespace normalization tweak that merges repeated punctuation. If token counts change, pooling offsets might shift. PTQ may be sensitive to final projection bias on short inputs.

nora (prod-eng): please don't promote v3 to staged traffic yet. Hold the canary and mark the build as 'investigating'.

ops-bot: Canary run: canary-3290012345-a started 2026-03-01T15:12:00Z. Link: https://ci.internal/canaries/3290012345-a

marie (evals): repro command I ran (copied):
```
./bin/rerank_eval --model v3-rerank-int4 --cohort holdout-5k --scoring dotprod --tokenizer v2norm --save ./out/v3-int4/diffs.jsonl
```
I also re-ran baseline with tokenizer v2norm for parity.

oliver (data): quick sanity check: what's pooled embedding norm distribution?

marie (evals): baseline median 6.8, v3-int4 median 6.2 (small), but for short-query pairs the cosine similarities shift more than expected. Dot-product scoring seems to amplify small bias.

dan (ml): actions: 1) run same eval switching scoring to cosine to see if dotprod amplification is the culprit; 2) re-run v3-int4 with tokenizer v2legacy to test tokenization diffs; 3) replay a deterministic micro-batch with KVPACK toggled.

kai (infra): I'll instrument the canary to run two parallel jobs: one with KVPACK=true and one with KVPACK=false, same binary. That should be quick.

marie (evals): starting cosine probe now:
```
./bin/rerank_eval --model v3-rerank-int4 --cohort short-queries --scoring cosine --tokenizer v2norm --out short_cosine.json
```
Kickoff on canary-3290012345-a-1.

ops-bot: Job started: canary-3290012345-a-1 (cosine probe).

marie (evals): initial cosine results: short-query MRR@10 = 0.273 (baseline 0.294), still down but gap reduced from -24% to -7%. So cosine rescues some but not all.

dan (ml): that points to dotprod amplification + a small representational bias. Could be final linear bias term shifted in PTQ or quantized bias folding. Dump last-proj weights and biases please.

marie (evals): running dump script: `python tools/dump_proj.py --model v3-rerank-int4 --layer final --out proj_dump.txt` and saving artifacts.

oliver (data): I'll extract example pairs (q_77, q_2401, q_6339) and provide raw inputs + tokenization diffs to reproduce locally.

nora (prod-eng): operational request: tag the canary with `no-rollout` and include artifact links in the ticket. We need to pause any staged deployments.

ops-bot: Artifacts for run: https://ci.internal/artifacts/3290012345/v3-int4/

marie (evals): quick ad-hoc test: I re-scored baseline embeddings with a small learned bias added (+0.04) and that narrows the gap on short snippets. So bias term matters.

dan (ml): ok hypothesis: PTQ folding/rounding changed bias in final dense and dotprod combined with lower dynamic range for short inputs produces tie/noisy ordering. Plan: 1) re-PTQ preserving bias (calibrate bias per-channel), 2) add small learnable bias correction in serving as hotfix, 3) investigate tokenizer normalization revert if still confounded.

kai (infra): I'll enable a quick feature flag to apply bias-correction in the runtime (`RERANK_BIAS_ADJ=0.04`) for canary-only testing.

marie (evals): will run a canary with bias adj + kvpack false and post numbers. If MRR recovers to within 2% of baseline we can consider a limited rollout after ML sign-off.

oliver (data): shipping the reproducible short-cohort (2k) with provenance to /datasets/repro/3290012345/short_cohort.tar.gz

nora (prod-eng): thanks all. please keep the thread updated with the artifact links and final numbers.

ops-bot: Updated job canary-3290012345-a-2 finished: MRR@10(short)=0.287 (baseline 0.289, delta -0.002). Artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/3290012345/v3-int4/biashotfix
